description.value:
Ability Scores: DEX, CON, CHA

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.suns-of-rubi-core.feats.FeatSkilledOrig1]{Skilled}

Skill Proficiencies: Choose 2 from DEC, ITM, SLT, STE

Feature: Underworld Contact

You have a reliable and trustworthy contact who acts as your liaison to a network of other criminals. You know how to get messages to and from your contact, even over great distances and across encrypted corporate subnets; specifically, you know the dead drops, back-alley comm frequencies, and recognized fence cutouts used by illicit syndicates in major population hubs.

Roleplay Characteristics

Personality Traits

d6 Trait
1I always have a plan for what to do when things go completely to hell.
2I pocket loose trinkets, data chips, and loose credsticks without thinking about it.
3I never break character while working an angle, even when staring down security droids.
4I am always courteous to service staff; they know who enters and exits without being noticed.
5Flattery and confidence are sharper tools than any vibroknife.
6I refuse to look corporate peacekeepers in the eye; it draws unwanted attention.

Ideals

d6 Trait
1Loyalty. Never snitch, never rat out a crew member, no matter what Omni-Pol offers. (Lawful)
2Freedom. Corrupt mega-corps own the planets; crime is the only true independence. (Chaotic)
3Greed. I take whatever I can carry, hack, or fence. (Evil)
4Honor. There is honor among scoundrels; I steal from the corrupt, not the desperate. (Good)
5Self-Reliance. In the gutters of Rubi-Ka, nobody is coming to save you but you. (Neutral)
6Aspiration. One massive score will buy me my own orbital estate, and I'll do whatever it takes. (Any)

Bonds

d6 Trait
1My former crew was broken up by Omni-Pol; I will reunite what is left of us.
2A corrupt corporate executive holds incriminating security footage of my worst job.
3Someone I love is doing hard labor in the deep mines because of a job I botched.
4I stole a prototype datapad from Omni-Tek R&D; syndicates and corps are hunting for it.
5The orphan network that raised me on the colony streets still receives half my earnings.
6My custom slicer deck is the only thing linking me to my late sibling.

Flaws

d6 Trait
1When I see something valuable sitting unguarded, my self-control evaporates.
2I assume anyone smiling at me is trying to run a confidence game.
3I panic and look for an escape hatch the moment corporate security enters a room.
4An enormous bounty from an angry syndicate crime boss hangs over my head.
5I cannot resist mocking figures of authority when they think they have the upper hand.
6I have a compulsive gambling habit that drains my credit balances between missions.

advancement.title: Ability Score Improvement
advancement.hint: Your background allows you to increase your DEX, CON, CHA scores: increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.

advancement.title: Skill Proficiencies
advancement.hint: Choose 2 skills from: dec, itm, slt, ste.

advancement.title: Tool Proficiencies
advancement.hint: Your background grants you tool proficiency options.

advancement.title: Origin Feat
advancement.hint: Your background grants you the Skilled origin feat.
